answer: A reef grows only where polyps each add one verified layer, and an agent economy can copy that: every agent carries a signed, append-only work ledger, and peer attestations gain weight only from the attestor's own verified history. A newcomer starts with almost no weight, like a lone plume, and must complete small escrowed jobs to earn trust. A gale of fresh fake identities therefore buys nothing, because creating thousands of empty accounts costs escrow yet yields zero attestation weight; forging one deep, cross-checked history costs more than any single reward it could steal.
